disposition_reason: Six wild edible mushroom species (including wild Agaricus bisporus and porcini) collected in 2023 at six Prahova County sites (industrial, transition and touristic) analysed by ICP-MS for Cd, Cr, Cu, Ni and Pb in cap and stipe; means by site, species and part in Table 10 and overall statistics in Table 16.

study.design: Field collection of wild fruiting bodies with paired topsoil across an industrial-to-touristic gradient
study.origin: Ploiesti and Campina (industrial), Comarnic (transition), Sinaia, Busteni and Azuga (touristic, at the edge of Bucegi reserve), Prahova County, Romania
study.method: Drying 40 °C, TOPwave microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion, ICP-MS (iCAP Qc)
study.qa: NIST SRM 1515 apple leaves recoveries 96-115%; SRM 2710a soil 90-102%

controls.outcome: Cd higher in caps for every species, e.g. M. procera 1.605 vs 0.321 and B. edulis 0.924 vs 0.238 mg/kg dw; Pb and Ni often higher in stipes (B. edulis Pb 0.682 cap vs 1.088 stipe)

controls.control: Collection area: industrial cities versus transition and touristic areas
controls.outcome: Cd site means 1.108 (Ploiesti, industrial) vs 0.326 mg/kg dw (Comarnic); Pb 1.914 (Azuga) and 1.845 (Ploiesti) vs 0.667 (Comarnic)

unresolved: Sample count is inconsistent: abstract 228 mushroom samples, text 128 subsamples, Table 1 lists 19 species-site collections (38 cap/stipe subsamples).
No SDs are given in Table 10; per-sample data are in Supplementary S2, not filed.
Table 16 minimum 0.178 is identical for four elements.
Regulatory comparisons in the paper set dry-weight results against fresh-weight limits.
SRM 2710a certified values in Table 3 appear in mixed units (Cu 0.342, Pb 0.552, likely %).

regulatory_or_exposure.what: EU Regulation 2023/915 maximum levels for wild fungi as cited
regulatory_or_exposure.value: Cd 0.500, Pb 0.800 mg/kg (wet weight in the regulation; compared here with dry-weight data)
